title: [finding] The record page draws ManagedByBadge (「身份」 for better-auth objects) outside the page tree, so a host page cannot leave it out
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2773 dev report (cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2786). ⛔ Not graded: grading is triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The claim

The maintainer accepted, for the cloud console's workspace page (`sys_organization`), "no 「身份」 badge" (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 1 → objectstack-ai/cloud#2773, acceptance 2). Cloud now ships its own `sys_organization` record page (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2786), but the badge is not part of any page.

## Evidence (objectui at cloud's pin `d758f2f2`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:2874` renders `ManagedByBadge` for `objectDef.managedBy`, outside the page tree. The badge is `packages/app-shell/src/components/ManagedByBadge.tsx`, with i18n `managedByBadge.betterAuth.short` = 「身份」.
- No page slot, spec key or host option suppresses it.
- Served `sys_organization.managedBy` = `better-auth`, measured on an in-process control-plane boot.

## Why it matters

An end user on a workspace page sees an implementation word, 「身份」 (the auth library manages this object), with no meaning to them. The badge is useful in Studio and for admins. It is noise on an end-user record page that a host has deliberately authored.

## Options (not chosen here)

- (a) The badge only renders where authoring is offered (Studio / admin), or not on a page the host declares.
- (b) A page-level or object-level declared switch that the renderer honours. This is contract-first, so a spec key comes first.

Delivery note: cloud's objectui-alone pin bumps stop at `82bb1d5842` until cloud's framework pin moves to v18 (pin-pair rule, objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 `6116951023`).

Dedupe: searched objectui for `ManagedByBadge`, the betterAuth badge and the 身份 badge on record pages. The only hit, objectui#11866, is a different badge (role).
